[[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]] (epilogue) |series=[[Star Wars: The Old Republic (novel series)|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' novel series]] |preceded by=''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]'' |followed by="[[The Old Republic: The Third Lesson|The Third Lesson]]" }} '''''The Old Republic: Revan''''' is the third in a series of novels based on the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and features the character [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who was the player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. Written by ''Knights of the Old Republic'' lead writer [[Drew Karpyshyn]], the novel was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]]. The book also contains a preview of [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]. The audio version of the book is voiced by [[Marc Thompson]]. The paperback was released on [[September 25]], [[2012]].
